summary: Atypia of undetermined significance. Bethesda 2023: repeat FNA, molecular testing, diagnostic lobectomy or surveillance; total thyroidectomy is not the default.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Lump in the front of the neck
inputs.hpi: Noticed a painless lump on the right side of the front of her neck 2 months ago. Moves when she swallows. No voice change, no difficulty swallowing or breathing. No palpitations, heat intolerance or weight change. No neck irradiation in childhood. No family history of thyroid cancer.

exam.general: Well. Euthyroid clinically. 2 cm firm, smooth nodule in the right thyroid lobe, moves on swallowing, not fixed. No cervical lymphadenopathy. Trachea central.

imaging.name: USS thyroid
imaging.result: Right lobe 2.2 cm solid, hypoechoic, wider-than-tall nodule with smooth margins and no echogenic foci — ACR TI-RADS TR4 (4 points). Left lobe normal. No abnormal cervical lymph nodes.

imaging.name: US-guided FNA thyroid nodule (cytology)
imaging.result: US-guided FNA right thyroid nodule — cytology: Bethesda III, atypia of undetermined significance (AUS).

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Right thyroid nodule TR4 — FNA Bethesda III (AUS)
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Right thyroid nodule TR4, FNA Bethesda III (AUS). Options: repeat FNA, molecular testing, diagnostic hemithyroidectomy or surveillance — MDT and patient preference.

mustExclude.note: Total thyroidectomy is not a standard first operation for an indeterminate unilateral nodule.
mustExclude.knownGapNote: computeClinicalPrompts "thyroidectomy_pathway" fires on any radiology result containing "bethesda" (any category) and attaches the TOTAL THYROIDECTOMY operative plan.
mustExclude.proposedFix: Parse the Bethesda category and branch: I repeat FNA; II surveillance; III–IV repeat FNA / molecular / diagnostic lobectomy; V–VI surgery by risk (total thyroidectomy for cN1, >4 cm, ETE).

emergencyLevel.knownGapNote: Triage same_day_call: adaptiveTriage RED_FLAGS regexes have no negation handling ("No family history of thyroid cancer" → "Possible malignancy").
emergencyLevel.proposedFix: Add a negation window ("no", "denies", "never", "non-") before RED_FLAGS / symptom regex matches in adaptive-triage.

guideline.name: The 2023 Bethesda System for Reporting Thyroid Cytopathology
guideline.section: Diagnostic categories I–VI and usual management (I repeat FNA with US guidance; II clinical and US follow-up; III repeat FNA, molecular testing, diagnostic lobectomy or surveillance; IV molecular testing, diagnostic lobectomy; V molecular testing, lobectomy or near-total thyroidectomy; VI lobectomy or near-total thyroidectomy)
guideline.citation: Ali SZ, Baloch ZW, Cochand-Priollet B, Schmitt FC, Vielh P, VanderLaan PA. The 2023 Bethesda System for Reporting Thyroid Cytopathology. Thyroid. 2023;33:1039–1044.

guideline.name: 2015 American Thyroid Association guidelines — thyroid nodules and differentiated thyroid cancer
guideline.section: Nodule evaluation (TSH first; radionuclide scan when TSH is subnormal; hyperfunctioning nodules do not need FNA); cytology-directed management; extent of surgery (total thyroidectomy for cN1 disease)
guideline.citation: Haugen BR, Alexander EK, Bible KC, et al. 2015 American Thyroid Association management guidelines for adult patients with thyroid nodules and differentiated thyroid cancer. Thyroid. 2016;26:1–133.

rationale: Bethesda series (Bethesda III (AUS)). Same patient and nodule as the base; only the cytology result (recorded as a resulted report) and the surgeon's assessment change, so any change in output is driven by the category. Tests that management follows the 2023 Bethesda category.
